purpose.zh: 练侧腹和核心的旋转控制
purpose.en: Build the obliques and rotational core control.

text.zh: 上身后倾背挺直，胸廓慢慢转向一侧
text.en: Lean back with a long spine and slowly turn your ribs to one side

text.zh: 膝盖和骨盆保持朝前，脚跟着地
text.en: Keep your knees and pelvis facing forward and your heels down.

text.zh: 回到中间，再转向另一侧
text.en: Return through the center, then turn to the other side.

commonErrors.en: Swinging the arms without turning the chest.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
